normative_overrides.expected_original: Parse finite positive decimal inputs into exact rationals; apply exact source ratios. Compare/rank unrounded rational USD values. Display rounding cannot decide eligibility.
normative_overrides.reason: Distinguish signed additive actions from positive multiplicative components without changing cap definition or selection law.
normative_overrides.replacement: Parse finite decimal strings into exact rationals with numeric-role validation. Actual positive-class share-count measurements, raw prices, quote-unit scales, FX rates, and multiplicative split/conversion/ADR factors must be strictly positive. Additive corporate-action share deltas may be negative, zero, or positive in the source-proved class/share units: preserve the sign, economic event identity, effective ordering, and dependency bindings. A zero delta is permitted only as an explicitly evidenced no-change value, never as missing evidence. Resulting shares for every included positive-valued class and the final issuer capitalization must be strictly positive; a supported zero/ceased-class assertion remains a separately typed fact and cannot be silently omitted or treated as a missing numeric factor. Cardinality counts are nonnegative integers, excluding booleans. Nonfinite values, booleans and binary floating-point inputs are invalid numeric values. Do not use absolute values, clipping, partial-class omission or imputation to make an invalid value pass. Compare/rank unrounded exact rational USD values; display rounding cannot decide eligibility. The signed-delta exception never admits a nonpositive price, FX rate or multiplicative factor.
